_comment: SAMPLE DATA — live risks and blockers. Each challenge maps to a GitHub Issue (issueNumber) where discussion happens. severity: low | medium | high | critical. status: open | mitigating | resolved. Optional `country`: country id when the challenge is market-specific — the dashboard links it to that country page.

challenges.title: First-call deck adoption lagging
challenges.summary: Only 30% of sellers using the new deck; older materials still circulating. Mitigation: enablement push plus deprecating old assets in the content library.

challenges.title: Launch budget envelope unconfirmed
challenges.summary: Finance may phase spend across Q4/Q1, which would constrain tier-1 launch activities. Decision needed at Thursday budget review.

challenges.title: Enablement platform migration slip
challenges.summary: L&D platform migration delayed two weeks — enablement path go-live (m3, 21 Aug) at risk. Options: interim delivery via Teams live sessions, or shift milestone.

challenges.title: Win/loss interview scheduling
challenges.summary: Customer contacts slow to respond over summer holidays. Mitigation: widened outreach pool and added incentive voucher.
